full_text:
Attached Form 5
Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Attached Form 5] <Amended on October 1, 2025>

APPLICATION FOR [ ] ISSUANCE / [ ] REISSUANCE OF AN ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATOR CERTIFICATE

The applicant shall not complete the dark-shaded fields. Place a check mark (√) in the applicable [ ] box.

Receipt number: __________
Date of receipt: __________
Processing date: __________
Processing period: 30 days

Applicant
Name (in Korean): __________
Resident registration number: __________
Telephone number: __________
Address: __________

Institution at which training was completed
Institution name: __________
Period of course attendance: ____ . ____ . ____ to ____ . ____ . ____

Reason for application

[ ] Issuance
Qualification grade: Environmental educator, Grade ____
Qualification requirements: __________

[ ] Reissuance
Number of the originally issued certificate: Environmental educator, Grade ____, No. ____
Reason for reissuance: __________

I hereby apply for issuance or reissuance of an environmental educator certificate under Article 16 of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education and Article 4(1) or (3) of its Enforcement Rule.

Year ____ Month ____ Day ____
Applicant: __________ (signature or seal)

To: Head of the National Environmental Education Center

Accompanying documents

Issuance
1. Documents proving compliance with the qualification requirements under Article 15(1) and Appendix 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education.
2. One copy of a basic certificate under the Act on Registration of Family Relations.

Reissuance
1. One copy of a basic certificate under the Act on Registration of Family Relations.
2. One environmental educator certificate (except where it has been lost).

Fee: None

Processing procedure
Preparation of the application → Receipt of the application → Verification of qualifications → Preparation of the certificate → Issuance of the certificate (entry in the issuance register).

Preparation of the application: Applicant. Receipt of the application: National Environmental Education Center. Verification of qualifications and preparation of the certificate: Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and Minister of Oceans and Fisheries (shown jointly under these two stages). Issuance of the certificate: National Environmental Education Center.

210 mm × 297 mm [white paper (80 g/m²)]
